primary_citation: CHIME/FRB Collaboration (M. Amiri et al.) 2021, "The First CHIME/FRB Fast Radio Burst Catalog," The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 257, 59
erratum_citation: CHIME/FRB Collaboration 2023, "Erratum: 'The First CHIME/FRB Fast Radio Burst Catalog' (2021, ApJS, 257, 59)," ApJS, 264, 53
erratum_summary: Corrects a normalization bug and a selection-criteria bug in the all-sky burst rate calculation (Section 6.2 only): rate revised from 820(+220/-200) to 525(+142/-131) bursts/sky/day. Does not mention any correction to per-burst catalog columns (DM, width, spectral index, sky position, repeater flag). This project does not use the all-sky rate and is unaffected by the erratum.
provider: CDS VizieR (mirror of the published catalog table)
official_site_note: chime-frb.ca / chime-frb-open-data.github.io was reported temporarily unavailable ('rebuilding') during data-access research for this project; VizieR was used as a stable, standard archive mirror instead.
cfod_package_note: The official 'cfod' Python package (chime-frb-open-data/chime-frb-open-data) only parses an already-downloaded local catalog file; it does not itself fetch or bundle Catalog 1 data, so it could not be used as the fetch mechanism.

verification.method: structural, not a fixed byte checksum, because VizieR's plain-text response embeds a per-request timestamp comment that changes on every fetch
checks: exactly 536 rows with sub_num == 0 (one row per catalog burst)
exactly 536 unique tns_name values among those rows
exactly 62 of those rows have a non-empty repeater_name
those 62 repeater bursts are drawn from exactly 18 unique repeater sources
verification.result: all four checks passed; matches the paper abstract's '536 ... including 62 bursts from 18 previously known repeating sources' exactly
verification.enforced_by: scripts/fetch_catalog.py aborts the fetch if any check fails

license: No formal open-data license is stated by the official CHIME/FRB site; it permits use in publications with citation of the relevant CHIME/FRB Collaboration papers. VizieR distributes CDS-hosted catalogs under its standard research-use terms.
raw_file_reason: No confirmed open redistribution license; the raw catalog is re-downloaded at reproduction time by scripts/fetch_catalog.py and written to data/external/ (gitignored), matching this maintainer's Fairshift Lab pattern.
excluded_flag_note: 39 of the 536 bursts have excluded_flag == 1 (excluded from parameter inference due to non-nominal telescope operation per the catalog's own ReadMe Note 6). This project drops those 39 from all statistical comparisons; see docs/research-protocol.md.
